diagnosis: Customer in ap-south attempting private networking. KB-0008 confirms private networking is unavailable in ap-south; feature is queued instead of failing. KB-0010 also indicates private networking requires premium plan, but the core issue is regional unavailability.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. Private networking is currently available in us-east, us-west and eu-west, but is not yet available in the ap-south region. When you attempt to enable it in an unsupported region, the request enters a queue rather than returning an error. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
